description:
crate-jmap-tasks-client/README.md and crate-jmap-filenode-client/README.md examples use the placeholder `jmap_base_client::JmapClient::new(/* ... */)`. At best ambiguous; at worst encourages users to call a non-existent constructor (see JMAP-sc1b.X for the broken signature).

Already covered by 'P1: 4 client READMEs use nonexistent JmapClient::new(string) signature'. Filing as separate P3 because the placeholder vs string-arg flavors are slightly different fixes — the placeholder ones can be fixed more cheaply.
title: P3: tasks-client and filenode-client doc-test placeholders use 'JmapClient::new(/* ... */)'
